story.intro: In a world crowded with overdesigned footwear and loud marketing that tries too hard, we chose to go back in time—back to authenticity, fairness, and simplicity that speaks for itself.
story.origins: We revived a design that has always been a symbol of Shaolin strength and discipline: the shoe worn by kung fu masters, seen in Henan Tempels, on global stages, and at the Olympics.
story.qualities: It's a timeless design that doesn’t age, crafted from simple materials proven to be comfortable, light, and durable. This shoe is a reminder that the things made without show-off or noise are the ones that truly last.
story.collaboration: We partnered with the original factory—the one that lost the rights to its own creation after an unfair legal battle. We chose to help return what was taken from them. Because fairness matters. Because craft should remain in the hands that built it.
story.learnMore: Learn more about Lqdam and about DAFU Rubber Company, the factory that started the story.

philosophy.intro: Every Lqdam pair carries the same spirit as the original: flexible, steady, and made for movement.
philosophy.design: Lqdam is light, comfortable, and built to last—designed to offer lasting comfort, simply, without complexity, and at a fair price.
philosophy.simplicity: Lqdam, which means "Leap Forward" in Arabic, is a movement and a voice we want everyone to hear. It's a message that says: what was taken should be returned to its rightful owners, and that you should stand bold, stay unafraid, and always move forward.
philosophy.learnMore: Learn more about our story here.

AboutFull.title: L9dam — Our Story
AboutFull.intro:
In a world full of noise — notifications, trends that last minutes, designs that overreach to grab attention, and marketing that exploits more than it inspires — L9dam was born with the courage to simplify.
A movement that believes true progress begins with honesty, not noise; with roots, not surface.
L9dam means “the leap forward” in Arabic.
We believed that to leap forward, we must first look back.
L9dam returns to the past not out of nostalgia, but for clarity.
We looked back so we can move forward with intention — with meaning, purpose, and awareness of who we are.
L9dam was born from Arab spirit — from a generation of youth whose voices, talents, and ideas deserve to be seen and heard.
This movement exists to empower and include.
To stand for the underrepresented.
To give space to stories rarely shown in glossy campaigns.
AboutFull.inspiration:
To understand L9dam, you need to walk into Shanghai — its narrow alleys, old martial arts schools, and the DaFu rubber workshops.
For decades, they created the Shanghai Kung Fu shoe — a simple canvas shoe worn by Shaolin monks, masters, students, workers, and everyday people.
This shoe traveled through time not because of trends or marketing, but because it simply worked.
It became a cultural symbol, passed across generations and borders.
Its journey wasn't always easy — ownership changed, stories shifted, noise increased — but the spirit remained.
A humble design, built with sincerity, earning its place in history.
That spirit is what inspired us.
AboutFull.why:
We chose to work directly with the original makers in Shanghai to revive the essence of the Shanghai Kung Fu shoe — not as a copy of the past, but as a foundation for modern movement, meaning, and purpose.
L9dam exists to remind us that simplicity is strength.
That heritage is not a burden but a compass.
That the real leap forward happens when you know where you come from and where you want to go.
A shoe made for movement — physically, culturally, and personally.
Made for the youth shaping tomorrow.
Made for storytellers, fighters, creators, the overlooked, and the brave.
A shoe that inspires you to move — with clarity, honesty, and confidence — always forward… L9dam.
